items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: Myra was a very beautiful, beautiful lady... and one of the finest women I ever knew.

ctx.x: That was a Cavanaugh. One of the top quality derbies. He bought it in New York City and gave it to him. Blaze D'Antoni gave Sharpie his King Trumpet. Yeah. It was a gold King Trumpet. Remember I told you how Sharpie used to take that $600... ...gold horn and... Mm-hmm. ...use a... Uh... This is Myra Menville. And her two children at the time. Myra was a very beautiful, beautiful lady... ...and one of the finest women I ever knew.
